subject: literacy
concept: Formulating an original, arguable thesis question about literature worth sustained research
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 literacy sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student sorts candidate questions into 'too broad,' 'too narrow/factual,' and 'genuinely arguable' categories
exercise.abstract: Student writes an original, specific, and arguable thesis question about a literary topic of their choosing

misconception_flags: writes a question with a single factual answer rather than one requiring genuine interpretive argument

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
